name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 37 - Am 42
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 37b. States that no housing unit that has been constructed wholly or partially with public funds, or that has received any percentage of financial support from public resources, should be sold, transferred, or otherwise made available on the private real estate market; underlines that all housing should remain under public ownership, social housing schemes, or alternative non-market arrangements, in order to preserve affordability and ensure continued access for eligible households;
